The three visible rivets attaching the handle appear slightly irregular in shape and spacing. They look more like painted dots than raised metallic hardware, lacking proper specular highlights and depth.

The text on the glass bottle in the background is illegible and warped, which is common in AI generation but could also be due to depth of field blur. However, the warping seems inconsistent with the lens curvature.
